carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and lower luminance shadows on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes swimming in close parallel proximity to the ventral-most visible edge of the shark profile.
